title: Catalogue job request (POST /catalogues; poll GET /catalogues/<key>; result GET /catalogues/<key>/asset)
description: Sent by the control plane when the repository snapshot turns ready. No sandbox and no clone: the controller reads only what is sent. `files` maps each indexed text path to its text (the snapshot's own files object, at most 8 MB, as indexed); `graphLabels` is the graph's node labels (symbol names) for grouping hints. The asset is a catalogue.json document (with `learn`, intake-run-or-learn-spec 2) (schemas/catalogue.json). Status answers schemas/status.json with the catalogue states: queued, discovering (rule pass), planning (the one model call), ready, failed (error carries a plain reason; failed no_catalogue after the one re-ask).

catalogue.description: Optional: the stored catalogue document of this repo and commit. When present the controller makes ONLY the learn call and returns this document with `learn` added (routes kept, no version bump); a document that already has `learn` is returned as is, with no model call.
